Sandbox_TheCoroner_XpMultiplier_tooltip:
Multiplies all First Aid XP given by the mod. Combined with the per-activity multipliers below (global x activity).
1 = default, 0 = no XP at all.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_AutopsyXpMultiplier_t:
XP from the autopsy minigame: incision, skin, ribs, chest plate and organs.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TimeOfDeathXpMultipli:
XP from a correct time of death estimate.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_CauseOfDeathXpMultipl:
XP from a correct cause of death conclusion.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TremorMultiplier_tool:
Multiplies how much the hands shake during the autopsy minigame (incision, ribs, organs).
1 = default, 0.5 = half as much, 0 = perfectly steady hands.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TimeOfDeathMaxRatio: Time of death: maximum range width
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TimeOfDeathMaxRatio_t:
How wide a time of death estimate can be: the upper bound can be at most this many times the lower bound (e.g. 6 = "between 10 h and 60 h").
Lower = harder. Narrower correct estimates give more XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_OrgansEdible_tooltip:
[!] On a save that is already running, restart the game or server after changing this option. [!]

On: organs can be eaten raw or cooked and added to stews, soups and stir fries.
Off: no Eat option and no cooking recipes. They can still be cooked, used as fishing bait or chum, and used in the mod's crafting recipes.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_OrgansInfectious_tool:
On: eating an organ from an infected body infects you (unless zombie infection is disabled in Zombie Lore).
Off: infected organs are as safe as the others.
Organs already taken out keep their current state.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_MorgueCorpseChance_to:
Chance for each morgue drawer to hold a body the first time it is loaded.
0 = always empty.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_MorgueCorpseInfectedC: Chance for a body found in a morgue drawer to be infected (bite present, dangerous organs).
